description: RaPId, published by ALSETLab, calibrates and validates dynamic power-system models by combining parameter optimisation with Modelica simulation through MATLAB, Simulink and the FMI Toolbox. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is LGPL-3.0; GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: A free repository does not provide licences for MATLAB, Simulink or the required FMI tooling. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
